metadata.title: hyperCAD-S Mesh Operations - Complete Enumeration
metadata.description: Exhaustive parameter catalog for hyperCAD-S Mesh Modeler. Mesh inputs (STL / OBJ / PLY / 3MF / scan data) feed two downstream paths: conversion to NURBS surface or BRep solid for parametric machining, or feature-line extraction for direct toolpath generation in hyperMILL. Catalog covers: 1 import op (Insert), 2 conversion ops (Convert-to-BRep / Convert-to-Surface), 4 modify ops (Reduce / Smooth / Repair / Remesh), 1 Boolean op (mesh-mesh union/subtract/intersect), 2 cut ops (Plane-Cut / Clip-Volume), 1 feature-extraction op (Extract-Feature-Lines for hyperMILL), and 1 additive prep op (Slice-For-Additive).
metadata.source: OPEN MIND hyperCAD-S Mesh Reference, hyperMILL Feature-Line Toolpath Reference

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across hyperCAD-S mesh operations

MESH_INSERT.description: Import a mesh body from STL / OBJ / PLY / 3MF / SCAN file. Optional automatic repair pass and unit-system conversion at import time.

parameters.name: File Path
parameters.description: Absolute path to mesh file

parameters.name: Placement Origin
parameters.description: World-coordinate insertion point (defaults to origin)

parameters.name: Auto Repair On Import
parameters.description: Run a basic repair pass (close gaps, drop zero-area facets) at insert time

MESH_CONVERT_TO_BREP.description: Convert a mesh body into a BRep solid by faceted-surface fit. Each triangle becomes a planar face; output volume matches mesh enclosed volume within tolerance. Coarser than CONVERT_TO_SURFACE but faster and watertight by construction.

parameters.name: Volume Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum volume difference between mesh and BRep result

parameters.name: Coplanar Merge Angle
parameters.description: Adjacent faces within this normal-angle threshold get merged into one BRep face

parameters.name: Suppress Source Mesh
parameters.description: Hide source mesh after conversion

MESH_CONVERT_TO_SURFACE.description: Convert a mesh into a NURBS surface set by region segmentation + per-region surface fit. Mesh-workspace entry point with mesh-domain defaults — pairs with surface_operations.MESH_TO_SURFACE which is the surface-workspace entry.

parameters.name: Curvature Threshold
parameters.description: Crease angle separating regions (Segmentation Mode = auto_curvature)

parameters.name: Fit Tolerance
parameters.description: Max deviation of surface from mesh

parameters.name: Stitch Output
parameters.description: Stitch result surfaces into a shell

MESH_REDUCE.description: Decimate (reduce) triangle count while staying within deviation tolerance. Used to shrink dense scan-data meshes for faster downstream processing.

parameters.name: Target Triangle Count
parameters.description: Absolute triangle count target (Reduction Mode = target_count)

parameters.name: Target Ratio
parameters.description: Fraction of original count, 0..1 (Reduction Mode = target_ratio)

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Hard upper bound on geometry displacement

parameters.name: Preserve Sharp Features
parameters.description: Lock sharp-feature edges during decimation

MESH_SMOOTH.description: Smooth (denoise) mesh by repositioning vertices toward neighborhood average within tolerance. Used for scan-data noise removal.

parameters.name: Smoothing Weight
parameters.description: 0 = preserve shape, 1 = maximum smoothing

MESH_REPAIR.description: Repair common mesh defects: holes, zero-area facets, duplicate vertices, non-manifold edges, inverted normals. Mesh-domain analog of healing AUTO_HEAL.

parameters.name: Hole Fill Max Size
parameters.description: Largest hole that gets auto-filled

parameters.name: Vertex Merge Tolerance
parameters.description: Vertices closer than this get merged

MESH_REMESH.description: Re-tessellate mesh with controlled triangle size and shape. Used to produce uniform meshes from non-uniform scan data or to refine coarse meshes for finer toolpath sampling.

parameters.name: Target Edge Length
parameters.description: Desired edge length for output triangles

parameters.name: Adaptive
parameters.description: Vary edge length by curvature (smaller in high-curvature regions)

parameters.name: Curvature Sensitivity
parameters.description: How aggressively edge length shrinks with curvature, 0..1 (Adaptive = true)

parameters.name: Maximum Deviation
parameters.description: Hard upper bound on geometry displacement

MESH_BOOLEAN.description: Boolean op (union / subtract / intersect) between two mesh bodies. Faster than BRep Boolean but produces non-watertight results that often require MESH_REPAIR after.

parameters.name: Auto Repair Result
parameters.description: Run MESH_REPAIR on result before returning

parameters.name: Snap Tolerance
parameters.description: Coplanar-edge snap distance during intersection

MESH_PLANE_CUT.description: Cut mesh by a plane. Returns one or both sides; optionally caps the cut with a planar face for closed result.

parameters.name: Cutting Plane
parameters.description: Origin plane / planar face / reference plane

parameters.name: Cap Cut
parameters.description: Insert planar face along the cut to keep result closed

MESH_CLIP_VOLUME.description: Clip mesh by a closed volume body. Retains mesh region inside (or outside) the clipping volume.

parameters.name: Clipping Volume
parameters.description: Closed solid / mesh body acting as clip

MESH_EXTRACT_FEATURE_LINES.description: Extract feature lines (sharp edges and silhouette curves) from a mesh. Output curve set is the canonical input to hyperMILL feature-line toolpaths — direct path from scan data to NC code without going through surface fit.

parameters.name: Sharp Angle Threshold
parameters.description: Edges with normal-angle defect above this are flagged as sharp

parameters.name: Include Silhouettes
parameters.description: Also extract view-dependent silhouette curves

parameters.name: View Direction
parameters.description: View direction for silhouettes (Include Silhouettes = true)

parameters.name: Curve Smoothing
parameters.description: Smoothing weight applied to extracted curves, 0..1

parameters.name: Minimum Curve Length
parameters.description: Drop extracted segments shorter than this

MESH_SLICE_FOR_ADDITIVE.description: Slice mesh into a stack of planar contours for additive manufacturing (FDM / SLA / SLS). Output is per-layer 2D contour set ready for slicer software.

parameters.name: Build Direction
parameters.description: Layer-stack axis (defaults to +Z)

parameters.name: Layer Height
parameters.description: Slice spacing along build direction

parameters.name: Adaptive Layers
parameters.description: Vary layer height with surface curvature

parameters.name: Min Adaptive Layer
parameters.description: Lower bound on adaptive layer height

parameters.name: Max Adaptive Layer
parameters.description: Upper bound on adaptive layer height

platform_notes.two_paths: Mesh inputs feed two paths in hyperCAD/hyperMILL: (1) MESH_CONVERT_TO_SURFACE / MESH_CONVERT_TO_BREP for parametric machining, (2) MESH_EXTRACT_FEATURE_LINES for direct toolpath generation without surface fit.
platform_notes.non_watertight: MESH_BOOLEAN results are commonly non-watertight; chain MESH_REPAIR after for downstream BRep conversion.
platform_notes.scan_workflow: Typical scan-import workflow: MESH_INSERT → MESH_REPAIR → MESH_REDUCE → MESH_SMOOTH → MESH_CONVERT_TO_SURFACE → hyperMILL toolpaths.
